lines: This family has died four times in my game.
hook
Every soldier here is a real person who commented on my posts.
real
Yann Zaza, a medic, held post R F twenty-one. On day eight, a machine gun found him just after dawn. His tea was still hot.
yann
His heir, Albin, lasted one day. Shot in the back, passing ammunition along the trench.
albin
Then Emil. Killed in a night raid, by the same man who killed Yann.
emil
Then Karel. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall, and carved his own beneath them.
karel
He was killed on watch the next morning.
karel2
Today, Dietrich Zaza, the fifth, holds the same post. He is a medic too.
dietrich
Will he make it? Comment Hegemony or Concord, and your soldier joins the war.
cta
Mud and Iron. Free at mudandiron dot app.
end
